svg.title: The WingCLIP model family
svg.desc: BioCLIP-2: Imageomics · 304M, NABirds 86.41, teacher; WingCLIP-0.1-alpha: ViT-B/16 distill · 86.6M, NABirds 81.83; WingCLIP-0.1-beta: + ground-truth fine-tune; WingCLIP-0.1: + WiSE-FT, α 0.90, NABirds 89.93, teacher; WingCLIP-0.2-alpha: 0.2 recipe, NABirds 78.4, retired; WingCLIP-0.3-alpha: TinyCLIP-39M · 38.7M, NABirds 84.98; WingCLIP-0.3-beta: + fine-tune, fresh photos; WingCLIP-0.3: + WiSE-FT, α 0.60, NABirds 86.90, ships. WingCLIP-0.1 is the teacher of WingCLIP-0.3-alpha.
